adoption: The real team authority must version and adopt these policies through a pinned canonical source; this file invents no team, owner or approval. Story/task fields link exact adopted policy ID/version/content hash and applicable check evidence; keep item-specific additions separately.

checks.title: Bounded and traceable
checks.criterion: One canonical item, current source/parent/scope revision and no competing duplicates.

checks.title: Testable outcome
checks.criterion: User/operator outcome, acceptance/evaluation contract, source supplements and applicable adverse/refusal/failure/recovery scenarios are explicit.

checks.title: Feasible and prioritised
checks.criterion: Sourced priority rationale, size range/unit/uncertainty, required predecessor outputs, resources and access support the next step.

checks.title: Risk and discovery resolved
checks.criterion: Required riskiest-assumption test and decision exist; residual uncertainty has an actual authorized bounded risk decision if permitted.

checks.title: Applicable assurance prepared
checks.criterion: Safety/security/privacy/accessibility and product AI dataset/rights/metrics/fallback/versioning/promotion/monitoring design prerequisites meet current-stage requirements.

checks.title: Actual approval recorded
checks.criterion: Every actual required product, human, legal/privacy/security/domain approval is independently evidenced at the current specification; quality review is not approval.

checks.title: Execution can proceed
checks.criterion: Canonical team policy is actually adopted; required owner/assignee, evaluation environment/access and decisions are resolved, item-specific additions satisfied, and blockers have actual owners/resume conditions.

checks.title: Current final revision qualified
checks.criterion: Reviewable deliverable revision and actual meaningful evaluation outputs meet the declared qualification method.

checks.title: Acceptance observed
checks.criterion: Each applicable frozen criterion has current original observed evidence; failures/refusals/recovery/prohibited effects and AI overall/critical-slice/safety thresholds meet the contract.

checks.title: Independent review current
checks.criterion: Required actual independent review and separate approvals exist at this revision; changed evidence invalidates old reviews. Offline advice cannot assert authorized review.

checks.title: Item-specific scope met
checks.criterion: Canonical team policy and item additions apply, scope/denominator is current, no required work hidden in done or silently skipped.

checks.title: Release authorised and observed
checks.criterion: Within declared item scope, actual required publication/integration authority and observations are recorded; task completion is not release approval.

checks.title: Availability and recovery verified
checks.criterion: Where the declared delivery gate requires it, observe exact operational revision and user/operator journey, actual recovery/fallback and live monitoring; published is not automatically available.

checks.title: Learning hand-off active
checks.criterion: Actual measurement owner, agreed review window, original target/data source and strategy/roadmap feedback route exist; observed learning remains a separate post-release gate.
